explanation: Physical threshold violation: eta electroproduction e p -> e' p eta has threshold W = 1.4861 GeV, but the requested W = 1.2 GeV is below threshold, so the eta cannot be produced. The hadronic table grid is [1.4856, 6.0000] GeV, so W = 1.2 is also outside table coverage (would require extrapolation). To compute eta radiative corrections, increase W to at least 1.4961 GeV (a safe grid start).
